scope: source-level proof for the public CPO ZeRO-3 path under the paper README's pinned training environment; not a distributed runtime execution

cpo.owner_only_hook: For each ZeRO-3 parameter, CPO computes a pending regularizer only for masked coordinates inside the current rank's partition and injects those global coordinates in that rank's full pre-reduce gradient. For any protected coordinate, exactly its owner rank carries the regularizer contribution.

deepspeed.reduction_fact: reduce_scatter_coalesced divides the full coalesced gradient buffer in-place by world_sz before reduce-scatter; ZeRO-3 requires gradient_predivide_factor==1.0 and postscale_gradients==true for reduce_scatter.

derivation.public_zero3_before_reduce_scatter: owner rank has g at the coordinate; all other ranks have 0
derivation.pinned_deepspeed_reduce_scatter: predivide every rank's full gradient by W, then sum/reduce-scatter corresponding partitions
derivation.owner_only_correction_to_match_single_ra: inject W * g on the owner rank before reduce-scatter

logging.public_code_behavior: Each rank accumulates only its partition's abs(diff)/global_n_masked partial contribution, then gather(...).nanmean() is logged after multiplying by lambda.
logging.exact_partition_cover_case: The sum of rank partials equals the full masked L1 contribution, while nanmean divides that sum by W. Therefore the logged ZeRO-3 mask_loss is also 1/W of the full masked-L1 value when partitions cover the support once.

contrast_with_zero2: In the non-ZeRO-3 path every data-parallel rank injects the same full regularizer contribution before gradient averaging, so the replicated regularizer survives averaging at its original magnitude; the owner-only ZeRO-3 partitioning is what introduces the extra 1/W factor.
scope_guard: This proves the scaling algebra for the cited public source paths and pinned version source, not that the paper's unpublished result-generating run used an identical code revision.

The proposed W multiplier must be tested under the pinned distributed runtime before adoption, especially with gradient accumulation, alternative communication modes, or any non-default reduction path.
This scaling correction is independent of the paper-spec global-TopP/global-normalization discrepancy and independent of state/transport optimizations.
